svg.aria-label: The Silk Road and Trade Routes
svg.title: The Silk Road and Trade Routes
svg.text: the overland Silk Road and the maritime spice route, ~200 BCE – 1450 CE
Solid = overland Silk Road (Chang'an/Xi'an ↔ the Mediterranean); dashed = maritime spice route.
Goods: silk, spices, porcelain, paper, gold. It also carried ideas, religions (Buddhism), and disease (the Black Death).
